feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook was solid—it hit a real pain point in robotics that I've seen in demos. I liked the 'stripping to skeletons' explanation, but you lost me a bit on 'multi-block condition dropout.' It sounds like a specific architectural tweak, but you didn't explain *why* dropping blocks makes it robust. Also, just throwing out 'FVD' without saying it stands for Frechet Video Distance makes it feel like you're just flexing acronyms.
